manifest_entry._door_hotspots_comment: #1585/#1647 PAINTED-DOOR HOTSPOTS (plate-pixel click targets in the 1344x768 registered plate; a click inside a hotspot routes exactly like clicking door_cell -> cross_door). The hotspot PIXEL is unchanged (the arch did not move) but its door_cell must track the live door — CombatSurfaceClient.TryDoorHotspot only fires for a cell present in _doorTo, so a stale cell draws a glow on the arch that does nothing.
